notes: Data Sorting is gone, replaced by Data Breach: a match-3 minigame. Swap tiles to line up 3+, take down Firewall tiles caught next to a match, and breach every Firewall before you run out of moves. Match-4 clears a row/column; match-5 clears the surrounding area.
Later biomes use a bigger mix of tile types and more Firewalls, not just fewer moves.
